package.description: Fast cross-platform CLI that organizes photos into date- and location-structured folders

en-US.description: Fast cross-platform CLI that organizes photos into date- and location-structured folders
en-US.longDescription:
photorg sorts a pile of photos into dated and optionally place-named folders.
It plans the whole run before touching anything, copies instead of moving by
default, never overwrites without --force, detects duplicates by content, and
can be interrupted and resumed. Reverse geocoding is offline: nothing touches
the network at runtime.
en-US.name: photorg
